items.title: S&P 500 9月僅跌0.5% 這15檔股票卻重挫逾20%
items.title_en: S&P 500 Down Only 0.5% in September, Yet 15 Stocks Plunge Over 20%
paras: 美股9月行情呈現指數表現與個股廣度明顯分化的局面。S&P 500指數9月下跌約0.5%，但截至9月30日收盤，約78%的成分股股價走低，顯示大型權值股的相對強勢掩蓋了市場內部更廣泛的下跌壓力。11大類股中有9個類股9月下跌，其中金融、房地產及非必需消費品類股跌幅最明顯。

根據FactSet資料，9月表現最差的15檔S&P 500成分股，跌幅均接近或超過20%。其中Fair Isaac (FICO-US)以約47.2%的跌幅墊底，2026年以來累計跌幅也擴大至64.2%，遠高於其他成分股。Gen Digital (GEN-US)9月下跌32.5%，年初至今下跌23.0%；Charter Communications (CHTR-US)下跌26.9%，年初至今跌幅達46.6%。
Equifax (EFX-US)9月下跌25.9%，2026年以來下跌35.4%；Axon Enterprise (AXON-US)下跌25.7%，年初至今跌25.9%；Intuit (INTU-US)下跌24.9%，年初至今跌59.3%。MGM Resorts International (MGM-US)下跌23.5%，但年初至今跌幅為13.3%。
Autodesk (ADSK-US)9月下跌21.8%，年初至今跌31.7%；Paychex (PAYX-US)下跌21.8%，年初至今跌11.2%；Albemarle (ALB-US)下跌20.7%，年初至今跌24.3%。Blackstone (BX-US)下跌20.5%，年初至今跌26.2%；Adobe (ADBE-US)則下跌20.1%，年初至今跌33.1%。
另外，Casey's General Stores (CASY-US)9月下跌19.9%，年初至今仍上漲9.0%；Lululemon Athletica (LULU-US)下跌19.6%，年初至今跌53.5%；Cooper Companies (COO-US)下跌19.6%，年初至今跌31.2%。由於跌幅採四捨五入計算，這3檔也被列入9月跌幅約20%的15檔股票。

Fair Isaac的跌勢尤其受到房貸信用評分制度變化衝擊。該股9月29日單日重挫約27%，原因是美國聯邦住房金融局(FHFA)局長Bill Pulte宣布，VantageScore資料將納入聯邦機構購買房貸的統一定價架構；同時，Rocket Mortgage宣布將VantageScore 4.0作為符合條件貸款的首選信用評分方式，市場因此重新評估Fair Isaac長期在房貸信用評分市場的地位。
不過，相關制度變化目前主要涉及聯邦層面的定價模型。Fannie Mae與Freddie Mac仍使用既有信用評分機構提供的信用評分作為房貸承保及證券化相關流程的一部分，因此Fair Isaac面臨的影響範圍仍取決於後續制度與市場採用情況。Equifax及TransUnion (TRU-US)同樣受到信用評分制度變化的市場影響。
Gen Digital的9月跌幅則與市場對公司收購GoDaddy的報導反應有關。市場資料顯示，Gen Digital股價在9月24日有關公司可能提出約120億美元收購GoDaddy的消息後明顯承壓。市場對於收購規模、融資方式以及整合網域與網路託管業務的疑慮，使股價進一步走弱。
從類股表現來看，9月跌勢並非集中於單一產業。金融類股下跌6.5%，房地產下跌6.2%，非必需消費品下跌6.2%，原材料下跌6.0%，公用事業下跌5.7%，工業下跌3.7%，能源下跌2.1%，必需消費品下跌1.9%，醫療保健則下跌0.2%。相較之下，資訊科技類股上漲4.8%，通訊服務類股上漲5.1%。
儘管9月市場廣度偏弱，S&P 500今年以來仍上漲12.4%。截至9月底，11大類股中有8類今年仍錄得上漲，其中能源類股年初至今上漲38.4%，資訊科技類股上漲28.3%，工業類股上漲8.6%，醫療保健類股上漲9.7%。金融類股則轉為年初至今下跌1.7%，公用事業下跌7.2%。
S&P 500的指數表現與成分股廣度之間的落差，也與市值加權結構有關。輝達(NVDA-US)單一股票就占追蹤S&P 500的SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust(SPY)約8.3%，其股價2026年以來上漲23.6%。因此，即使大量成分股下跌，只要大型權值股維持強勢，仍能對指數整體表現形成支撐。
從估值來看，S&P 500目前加權前瞻本益比約19.2倍，低於2025年底的22.2倍。FactSet資料顯示，過去12個月的獲利預估成長速度高於股價上漲速度，使整體指數的前瞻本益比有所下降。除醫療保健類股外，各主要類股的前瞻本益比也較2025年底出現不同程度變化。
15檔弱勢股中，部分公司的估值也已明顯低於去年底。例如Fair Isaac前瞻本益比從2025年底的39.9倍降至11.8倍，Albemarle從97.5倍降至10.5倍，Intuit從27.0倍降至11.4倍，Adobe則從14.8倍降至8.6倍。這些變化反映股價大幅下修，也顯示市場對相關企業未來獲利及估值水準的重新定價。

與最弱勢股票形成對比的是，9月仍有一批成分股大幅上漲。Bloom Energy (BE-US)上漲42.1%，Everpure (EVR-US)上漲41.8%，Intel (INTC-US)上漲33.6%，Skyworks Solutions (SWKS-US)上漲32.2%，Moderna (MRNA-US)上漲32.1%，Advanced Micro Devices (AMD-US)上漲30.0%。Illumina (ILMN-US)上漲28.4%，Meta Platforms (META-US)上漲27.3%，Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE-US)上漲25.0%，Marvell Technology (MRVL-US)上漲24.5%。
其中，Moderna第3季股價大幅上漲，主要受到公司與Merck合作的癌症疫苗臨床數據更新帶動；截至9月底，該股第3季累計上漲約173%。Fair Isaac則成為第3季表現最差的S&P 500成分股，3個月跌幅約49%，其中大部分跌幅集中在9月29日。
整體而言，9月S&P 500表面上僅小幅下跌，但個股表現明顯分化。大型科技與通訊服務類股維持相對強勢，支撐市值加權指數；另一方面，金融、房地產、非必需消費品及部分個別公司則遭遇明顯賣壓。Fair Isaac的信用評分競爭、Gen Digital的收購消息，以及多家企業估值重新調整，均成為9月個股劇烈波動的重要因素。
paras_en: U.S. equity markets in September showed a clear split between index performance and stock breadth. The S&P 500 fell about 0.5% for the month, but by the close on September 30 roughly 78% of its constituents were lower, indicating that the relative strength of large‑cap stocks masked broader market weakness. Nine of the 11 sector groups posted declines in September, with financials, real estate and consumer discretionary suffering the steepest drops.

According to FactSet, the 15 worst‑performing S&P 500 components in September each fell close to or beyond 20%. Fair Isaac (FICO‑US) led the pack with a roughly 47.2% slide, and its year‑to‑date loss has widened to 64.2% since the start of 2026, far outpacing peers. Gen Digital (GEN‑US) dropped 32.5% in September and is down 23.0% YTD; Charter Communications (CHTR‑US) fell 26.9% with a 46.6% YTD decline.

Equifax (EFX‑US) slid 25.9% in September and is down 35.4% for 2026; Axon Enterprise (AXON‑US) fell 25.7% and is down 25.9% YTD; Intuit (INTU‑US) dropped 24.9% and is down 59.3% YTD. MGM Resorts International (MGM‑US) fell 23.5% in the month but is only 13.3% lower YTD.

Autodesk (ADSK‑US) fell 21.8% in September and is down 31.7% YTD; Paychex (PAYX‑US) also slipped 21.8% with an 11.2% YTD loss; Albemarle (ALB‑US) dropped 20.7% and is down 24.3% YTD. Blackstone (BX‑US) fell 20.5% and is down 26.2% YTD; Adobe (ADBE‑US) declined 20.1% and is down 33.1% YTD.

Casey’s General Stores (CASY‑US) fell 19.9% in September but remains up 9.0% YTD; Lululemon Athletica (LULU‑US) slipped 19.6% and is down 53.5% YTD; Cooper Companies (COO‑US) also dropped 19.6% with a 31.2% YTD decline. Because the drops are rounded, these three are included among the roughly 20%‑down group of 15 stocks.

Fair Isaac’s tumble was especially driven by changes to mortgage credit‑scoring rules. On September 29 the stock plunged about 27% after FHFA Director Bill Pulte announced that VantageScore data would be incorporated into the federal agency’s standardized pricing framework for mortgage purchases, and Rocket Mortgage said it would use VantageScore 4.0 as the preferred score for qualified loans, prompting the market to reassess Fair Isaac’s long‑standing role in mortgage credit scoring.

However, the regulatory shift currently affects only the federal pricing model. Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac continue to rely on scores from existing credit‑rating agencies for underwriting and securitization, so Fair Isaac’s exposure depends on how the new framework and market adoption evolve. Equifax and TransUnion (TRU‑US) are likewise feeling the impact of the scoring‑system changes.

Gen Digital’s September decline was tied to market reaction to reports that the company might acquire GoDaddy. Data show the stock came under pressure after news on September 24 that a roughly $12 billion purchase was being considered, with investors questioning the deal size, financing and integration of domain and web‑hosting businesses, which further weighed on the share price.

Sector‑by‑sector, September’s weakness was not confined to a single industry. Financials fell 6.5%, real estate 6.2%, consumer discretionary 6.2%, materials 6.0%, utilities 5.7%, industrials 3.7%, energy 2.1%, consumer staples 1.9% and health care 0.2%. By contrast, information technology rose 4.8% and communication services climbed 5.1%.

Despite the weak breadth in September, the S&P 500 is up 12.4% year‑to‑date. By the end of September, eight of the eleven sectors had posted gains this year, led by energy (+38.4% YTD), information technology (+28.3% YTD), industrials (+8.6% YTD) and health care (+9.7% YTD). Financials have turned negative, down 1.7% YTD, and utilities are down 7.2%.

The gap between the index’s modest move and the broad decline in constituents also reflects the market‑cap weighting. Nvidia (NVDA‑US) alone accounts for about 8.3% of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY), and its price is up 23.6% since the start of 2026. Thus, even as many components fall, the strength of a few large‑cap stocks can still support the overall index performance.

On a valuation basis, the S&P 500’s forward‑looking P/E is now roughly 19.2×, down from 22.2× at the end of 2025. FactSet shows that earnings‑estimate growth over the past 12 months has outpaced price appreciation, pulling the forward P/E lower. Except for health‑care, all major sectors have seen their forward P/E ratios shift to varying degrees since the end of 2025.

Among the 15 laggards, several companies’ valuations have already fallen well below year‑end‑2025 levels. Fair Isaac’s forward P/E dropped from 39.9× to 11.8×, Albemarle from 97.5× to 10.5×, Intuit from 27.0× to 11.4× and Adobe from 14.8× to 8.6×, reflecting steep price corrections and a market re‑pricing of future earnings prospects.

In contrast, a group of constituents surged in September. Bloom Energy (BE‑US) jumped 42.1%, Everpure (EVR‑US) 41.8%, Intel (INTC‑US) 33.6%, Skyworks Solutions (SWKS‑US) 32.2%, Moderna (MRNA‑US) 32.1%, Advanced Micro Devices (AMD‑US) 30.0%, Illumina (ILMN‑US) 28.4%, Meta Platforms (META‑US) 27.3%, Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE‑US) 25.0% and Marvell Technology (MRVL‑US) 24.5%.

Moderna’s Q3 stock rally was driven mainly by updated clinical data on its cancer‑vaccine partnership with Merck, propelling a roughly 173% cumulative gain for the quarter by the end of September. Fair Isaac, by contrast, was the worst‑performing S&P 500 component in Q3, shedding about 49% over three months, with most of the decline concentrated on September 29.

Overall, September’s S&P 500 showed only a modest dip, but individual stock performance was highly divergent. Large‑cap tech and communication‑services stocks kept the market‑cap‑weighted index buoyant, while financials, real estate, consumer discretionary and several individual companies faced pronounced selling pressure. Fair Isaac’s credit‑scoring competition, Gen Digital’s acquisition news, and valuation resets across multiple firms were key drivers of the month’s stock‑level volatility.

items.title: 高盛延後Fed升息預測 由10月改為12月
paras: 隨著美國經濟數據與債市波動持續影響貨幣政策走向，市場對聯準會（Fed）短期內再次升息的預期有所降溫。投資機構高盛近日調整對聯準會的政策路徑預測，將下一次升息的時間點由 10 月延後至 12 月。
紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)公開表示，若經濟發展符合預期，今年再升息一次可能就已足夠。他強調，自 9 月升息後「目前沒有急於行動的必要」，聯準會可先審慎觀察更多經濟數據後再作抉擇。作為擁有聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)永久投票權的核心成員，威廉斯的表態備受市場關注。
他的經濟展望包括:

經濟成長: 今年美國國內生產毛額 (GDP) 預估成長 2.25%，經濟動能強勁，且可能進一步增強。
就業: 2027 年失業率預估為 4%。
通膨: 今年通膨率預估為 3.5%，到 2028 年回到 2% 目標。
風險: AI 投資持續增加，可能帶來額外通膨壓力。聯準會必須避免供給衝擊使高通膨持續下去。


儘管威廉斯週二並未完全排除 10 月升息的可能性，但其發言顯然傾向於「先觀察、後行動」。受此影響，市場對 10 月升息的預期機率迅速自 64% 降至 54%，週三升息機率進一步走低至 40%，2 年期公債殖利率則落在 4.887%。
政治敏感度與債市效應：10 月觀望機率大增
除了經濟數據外，政策時程與金融環境變化也為 10 月的利率決策添增變數。
10 月下旬的 FOMC 會議距離 11 月期中選舉僅剩不足一週，若在此敏感時刻採取升息動作，恐將引發總統川普及共和黨陣營的政治批判，指控聯準會意圖干預選情。儘管聯準會向來強調獨立性、不會因而迴避必要政策，但此時點的政治敏感度無疑上升。
此外，市場近期已自發性替聯準會完成了部分緊縮效果。自 8 月底以來，10 年期美債殖利率由約 4.61% 攀升至目前的 5.293%，大舉上揚約 67 個基點；2 年期公債殖利率亦從 8 月中旬的 4.26% 升至約 4.89%，增加約 63 個基點。
市場殖利率的快速顯著走升，顯著推高了家庭貸款與企業融資成本，實質上發揮了實體經濟緊縮的作用。這將為聯準會提供強烈理由，在 10 月會議上按下暫停鍵，以進一步評估債市緊縮對整體經濟所帶來的延遲影響。

items.title: 〈財報〉美光Q4優預期財測強勁 資料中心營收暴增11倍
items.title_en: Micron Beats Forecasts with Strong Q4; Data Center Revenue Surges 11‑Fold
paras: 美光科技(Micron Technology)(MU-US)周三(9/30)盤後公布2026會計年度第四季財報(截至9/3)，表現優於預期，資料中心營收更較去年同期暴增約11倍，這家記憶體晶片製造商持續受惠於AI基礎設施需求飆升。股價在盤後變動不大。
受惠於全球記憶體晶片供應緊張，美光股價過去一年大漲逾500%。這波供應短缺源自AI模型與工作負載對記憶體晶片創紀錄的需求，並推高記憶體成本，也導致包括蘋果iPad與MacBook在內的消費性電子產品價格上漲。
展望第一季，美光預期營收約為615億美元，調整後每股盈餘為38.15美元。LSEG調查的分析師原先預期，美光營收為570億美元，調整後每股盈餘為35.40美元。

FY 2027 Q1 財測 v.s. 華爾街預估


營收：615 億美元 v.s. 570 億美元
EPS：38.15 美元 v.s. 35.40 美元


根據公司聲明，美光第四季營收從去年同期的113.2億美元，增加至幾乎原來的4倍。
美光第四季淨利潤增至377億美元，或每股32.87美元，去年同期為32億美元，或每股2.83美元。
資料中心晶片帶動營收大幅成長。核心資料中心營收從15.8億美元增至180億美元，而雲端記憶體營收則達162.8億美元。

Q4 財報關鍵數據 v.s. LSEG預估


營收：542.3 億美元 v.s. 510.7 億美元
調整後EPS：33.42 美元 v.s. 31.61 美元


Gabelli Funds投資組合經理Hendi Susanto在財報公布後表示，這是「美光又一次強勁的業績超預期並上調財測」。
Susanto寫道，「截至目前，我還沒有聽到任何負面訊號，顯示記憶體景氣循環將在可預見的未來很快轉向下行。」
美光是美國唯一一家高頻寬記憶體(HBM)製造商。美光第四季DRAM營收較去年同期大增343%，達398億美元，占總營收的73%。
執行長Sanjay Mehrotra在財報電話會議上表示，公司擁有「強勁的未來HBM產品路線圖」，並正與輝達(NVDA-US)合作開發業界「首個客製化HBM方案」。
輝達與AMD等晶片巨頭的先進GPU與CPU，需要越來越多的HBM來處理AI工作負載，而全球領先的HBM供應商目前無法生產足夠的產品。
因此，美光正投資2,500億美元，在美國興建兩座新的HBM園區。規模最大的一座今年1月在紐約州Clay動工，而位於愛達荷州Boise的首座新晶圓廠預計明年開始運作。
HBM龍頭SK海力士與三星電子也正在南韓本土大規模擴建新的HBM工廠。美光在三大HBM供應商中的市占率最低，但其市值仍已突破1.2兆美元。
Mehrotra周二參加了由美國總統川普主持的AI監管峰會。幾天前，他才出席了川普在白宮舉行的晚宴，並與到訪美國的中國國家主席習近平會面。
Mehrotra在會議上表示，美光已在2026會計年度為每一名員工調高薪酬。數百名美光員工曾因勞資談判與薪資問題，威脅在台灣的工廠發動罷工。競爭對手SK海力士與三星電子也曾發生類似罷工事件，並因此發放超過50萬美元的獎金。
paras_en: Micron Technology (MU‑US) posted its fiscal 2026 fourth‑quarter results after the market close on Wednesday (Sept. 30), beating expectations. Data‑center revenue jumped roughly 11 times year‑over‑year, as the memory‑chip maker continues to benefit from soaring AI infrastructure demand. The stock was relatively unchanged after hours.

Benefiting from tight global memory‑chip supply, Micron’s share price has surged more than 500% over the past year. The shortage stems from record‑breaking demand for memory chips by AI models and workloads, which has pushed up memory costs and driven up prices for consumer electronics such as Apple iPads and MacBooks.

Looking ahead to the first quarter, Micron expects revenue of about $61.5 billion and adjusted earnings of $38.15 per share. Analysts surveyed by LSEG had originally forecast $57.0 billion in revenue and adjusted EPS of $35.40.

FY 2027 Q1 outlook vs. Wall Street estimates: Revenue $61.5 billion vs. $57.0 billion; EPS $38.15 vs. $35.40. According to the company, fourth‑quarter revenue rose from $11.32 billion a year ago to nearly four times that amount.
Micron’s fourth‑quarter net profit rose to $37.7 billion, or $32.87 per share, compared with $3.2 billion and $2.83 per share in the same quarter last year.
Data‑center chips drove the revenue surge. Core data‑center revenue grew from $1.58 billion to $18.0 billion, while cloud‑memory revenue reached $16.28 billion.

Q4 key figures vs. LSEG estimates: Revenue $54.23 billion vs. $51.07 billion; Adjusted EPS $33.42 vs. $31.61. Gabelli Funds portfolio manager Hendi Susanto said after the release that Micron delivered another strong beat and raised its outlook.
Susanto wrote, “So far I have not heard any negative signals indicating that the memory cycle will turn downwards in the near future.”
Micron is the only U.S. manufacturer of high‑bandwidth memory (HBM). Its fourth‑quarter DRAM revenue jumped 343% year‑over‑year to $39.8 billion, accounting for 73% of total revenue.
CEO Sanjay Mehrotra told investors on the earnings call that the company has a “strong future HBM product roadmap” and is working with Nvidia (NVDA‑US) on the industry’s first custom HBM solution.
Advanced GPUs and CPUs from Nvidia, AMD and other chip giants require ever more HBM to handle AI workloads, and the world’s leading HBM suppliers cannot produce enough units at present.

Therefore, Micron is investing $250 billion to build two new HBM campuses in the United States. The larger site broke ground in January in Clay, New York, and the first new fab in Boise, Idaho, is slated to start operations next year.

HBM leaders SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics are also expanding large‑scale HBM factories in South Korea. Although Micron has the smallest market share among the three HBM suppliers, its market value has already topped $1.2 trillion.

Mehrotra attended an AI‑regulation summit on Tuesday hosted by U.S. President Trump. A few days earlier he had joined a White House dinner hosted by Trump and met Chinese President Xi Jinping during his visit to the United States.

At the summit Mehrotra said Micron raised salaries for every employee in fiscal 2026. Hundreds of Micron workers had threatened to strike at its Taiwan plant over labor‑pay disputes. Competitors SK Hynix and Samsung have also faced similar strikes and have paid out more than $500,000 in bonuses.

items.title: 〈貴金屬盤後〉金價9月下挫6.6% Q3季線仍收紅
items.title_en: Precious Metals After Hours: Gold Prices Fall 6.6% in September, Q3 Trend Still Positive
paras: 黃金周三(30日)一度上漲，終場仍回吐漲幅，月線收黑，即使美國通膨數據比預期疲軟，使市場降低對聯準會(Fed)的升息預期拉抬黃金，但仍不敵能源價格居高不下以及美債殖利率上揚對黃金的打壓。

黃金現貨下跌0.7%，報每盎司4152.86美元，美國通膨數據公布後曾一度上漲。
美國黃金期貨收高0.2%，報每盎司4186.70美元。
黃金9月累計下跌6.6%，但第3季收紅上漲。


Zaner Metals副總裁兼資深金屬策略師Peter Grant說：「今天的走勢只是對昨日跌勢的修正。我仍認為黃金面臨一些相當大的阻力。」
金價周一重挫近4%，創6月10日以來最大單日跌幅，並跌至8月5日以來最低水準。美元走強、美國公債殖利率上升、能源價格攀升及通膨疑慮升溫，進一步強化市場對Fed升息的預期，均對金價構成壓力。
Grant表示：「市場對Fed進一步升息的預期升高，使美元持續走強，殖利率也維持在高檔。我認為今天金價上漲空間可能相當有限，市場將持續聚焦明天公布的個人消費支出(PCE)通膨數據，以及周五的就業數據。」
美元走升，逼近數月高點，主要受到波動劇烈的油價及近期美國公債殖利率快速攀升的支撐。
美元走強會使以美元計價的黃金對海外買家而言更加昂貴，美國公債殖利率上升則提高持有不孳息黃金的機會成本。同時，能源價格上漲可能推升通膨，迫使央行維持較高利率，以抑制價格壓力。
黃金傳統上被視為抗通膨資產，但在高利率環境下，其相較於具收益資產的吸引力通常會下降。
根據芝商所集團(CME)的FedWatch工具，目前市場預期Fed 10月升息的機率為68%，12月升息的機率則為95%。
投資人正等待包括ADP就業數據及周三公布的PCE數據等重要經濟指標，以及周五公布的非農就業數據。

其他貴金屬交易


現貨白銀下跌2.1%，報每盎司60.18美元。
現貨白金下跌0.4%，報每盎司1699.40美元。
現貨鈀金下跌1.5%，報每盎司1204.53美元。
三種貴金屬9月都下跌。
白銀和白金第3季都上漲，僅鈀金季線收黑。
paras_en: Gold rose briefly on Wednesday (the 30th) but gave back the gains by the close, ending the month in the red. Even though U.S. inflation data came in weaker than expected, lowering market expectations for further Fed hikes and giving a boost to gold, the metal was still weighed down by persistently high energy prices and rising U.S. Treasury yields.

Spot gold fell 0.7% to $4,152.86 per ounce after having spiked following the inflation release. U.S. gold futures rose 0.2% to $4,186.70 per ounce. Gold is down 6.6% for September overall, but the Q3 trend line remains in positive territory. Zaner Metals Vice‑President and senior metal strategist Peter Grant said, “Today’s move is merely a correction of yesterday’s decline. I still see considerable resistance for gold.”

Gold prices slumped nearly 4% on Monday, the biggest single‑day drop since June 10, and fell to their lowest level since August 5. A stronger dollar, higher U.S. Treasury yields, rising energy prices and renewed inflation concerns—all reinforcing expectations of further Fed rate hikes—put pressure on the metal.

Grant noted, “The market’s heightened expectation of additional Fed hikes is keeping the dollar strong and yields elevated. I think today’s upside potential for gold is quite limited, and the market will stay focused on tomorrow’s personal consumption expenditures (PCE) inflation data and Friday’s jobs report.”
The dollar continued its rise toward multi‑month highs, driven mainly by volatile oil prices and the recent rapid climb in U.S. Treasury yields.

A stronger dollar makes gold, which is priced in dollars, more expensive for overseas buyers, while higher Treasury yields raise the opportunity cost of holding non‑yielding gold. At the same time, rising energy prices could lift inflation, forcing central banks to keep rates higher to curb price pressures.
Gold is traditionally viewed as an inflation hedge, but in a high‑interest‑rate environment its appeal relative to income‑producing assets usually diminishes.
According to CME Group’s FedWatch tool, the market currently assigns a 68% probability to a Fed rate hike in October and a 95% probability to a hike in December.
Investors are awaiting key economic indicators, including ADP employment figures, Wednesday’s PCE data, and Friday’s non‑farm payroll report.

Other precious‑metal trading: Spot silver fell 2.1% to $60.18 per ounce, spot platinum slipped 0.4% to $1,699.40 per ounce, and spot palladium dropped 1.5% to $1,204.53 per ounce. All three metals are down for September. Silver and platinum posted Q3 gains, while palladium’s quarterly line remains in the red.

items.title: 川普證實上周向習近平提黎智英案 盼討論有成果
items.title_en: Trump Confirms He Raised Jimmy Lai Case with Xi Last Week, Hopes Discussion Yields Results
paras: 多家外媒報導，美國總統川普週三 (30 日) 表示，上週與中國國家主席習近平會面時，曾提及釋放政治犯的問題，並希望相關討論能取得成果。
川普於2024年競選總統期間接受專訪時，曾明確承諾「100%救出黎智英」。
記者週三詢問川普，是否曾在上週川普會上，向習近平提及香港媒體大亨黎智英，以及遭中國拘押的緬甸學者、美國公民敏辛 (Min Zin) 等人的個案。
川普回答:「我確實向習主席提過。確實有。」
川普表示，雙方進行了「非常、非常重要的討論」，並稱希望這些討論能有成果。
白宮在習近平訪美前曾表示，預期川普會提出在中國遭不當拘押者的個案，但未說明他是否打算直接觸及西藏、維吾爾穆斯林少數族群，以及中國新「民族團結」法律等更廣泛的人權議題。
爭取遭海外拘押的美國人獲釋，一直是川普的優先事項之一，其中包括遭中國拘押者。不過，他大致上避免公開談論中國對待藏人、維吾爾人及異議人士的方式。
paras_en: Multiple foreign media outlets reported that U.S. President Donald Trump said on Wednesday (the 30th) that during his meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping last week, he raised the issue of releasing political prisoners and hopes the related discussion will achieve results.
During a dedicated interview in his 2024 presidential campaign, Trump explicitly pledged to "100% rescue Jimmy Lai."

Reporters asked Trump on Wednesday whether, at last week's summit, he had mentioned Hong Kong media mogul Jimmy Lai as well as the cases of Burmese scholar and U.S. citizen Min Zin, who is detained in China.
Trump replied, "I did indeed bring it up with Chairman Xi. I really did."
Trump said the two sides had a "very, very important discussion" and expressed hope that those talks would bear fruit.

The White House, before Xi's visit to the United States, had said it expected Trump to raise cases of individuals improperly detained in China, but it did not specify whether he would directly address broader human‑rights issues such as Tibet, the Uyghur Muslim minority, or China's new "national unity" law.

Securing the release of Americans held abroad has long been one of Trump's priorities, including those detained by China. However, he generally avoids publicly commenting on China's treatment of Tibetans, Uyghurs, and dissidents.

items.title: Muse帶旺AI題材 Meta 9月暴漲27%創近四年最佳單月表現
items.title_en: Muse Boosts AI Theme as Meta Soars 27% in September, Marking Best Monthly Performance in Nearly Four Years
paras: Meta (META-US) 受惠於個人 AI 代理 Muse 的市場熱度，9 月股價暴漲約 27%，創 2022 年 11 月以來最佳單月表現。不過，隨著 OpenAI 推出競爭產品 Dots，分析師也開始關注 Muse 所需的基礎設施投入，能否為 Meta 帶來足夠回報。
Meta 週三 (30 日) 收低 1.84% 至每股 725.18 美元，較 8 月底的 572.34 美元上漲約 27%。這是公司上市以來第五大的單月漲幅，超越所有大型科技股同業，同期間那斯達克指數漲幅近 2%。
Meta 於 9 月 8 日推出 Muse 後，產品迅速受到歡迎，在蘋果 iOS 平台的下載量超越 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT，帶動華爾街對公司業務前景的樂觀情緒。
執行長祖克柏也在 9 月的年度 Connect 開發者大會上，將 Muse 定位為公司產品與業務策略的核心，並發表 Muse Charm AI 吊墜等新硬體。
然而，Muse 的成功也讓 AI 投資回報問題受到更多關注。
StoneX 分析師 Mark Zgutowicz 在週三研究報告中表示，Muse 對基礎設施的需求明顯更高，預期將加重市場對 Meta 投入資本報酬率 (ROIC) 的疑慮。他對 Meta 維持「持有」評等。
Meta 預計今年資本支出將倍增至約 1,400 億美元，以追上大型科技同業在 AI 領域的競爭步伐。
部分投資人擔心，這波支出能否產生足夠回報，而 Zgutowicz 認為，Muse 將增加相關壓力。
Muse 推出後，相應競爭也正在升溫。OpenAI 週二 (29日) 宣布將推出名為 Dots 的 AI 代理，目前採付費服務模式，Zgutowicz 預期，OpenAI 最終將推出使用量受限的免費方案，以擴大消費者採用，並引導用戶升級至付費服務。
Meta 則持續擴大 Muse 的商業應用，週二推出面向小型企業的 Muse for Small Business。
本週，Meta 也延攬 MongoDB 執行長 CJ Desai，領導新設立的 Meta Enterprise Platform 業務部門，進一步布局企業 AI 市場。
美銀全球研究分析師在週一報告中估計，包含雲端運算容量在內的企業 AI 解決方案市場，到 2028 年將超過 1 兆美元。
分析師認為，Meta 掌握的消費者資料與通訊應用程式，可望協助公司向以消費者為主要客群的企業銷售 AI 服務，並預期 Meta 的模型 API 將透過主要大型雲端平台提供。
Meta 上一次出現更大的單月漲幅是在 2022 年 11 月。當時 OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT，而 Meta 在經歷艱困的一年後，隨著效率提升計畫啟動，股價開始反彈，如今 Muse 再度帶動市場期待，促使 Meta 股價創 2022 年 11 月以來最佳單月表現。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) benefited from the market buzz around its personal AI agent Muse, with its September stock price jumping about 27%, delivering its best monthly performance since November 2022. However, as OpenAI rolled out competing product Dots, analysts are also focusing on the infrastructure investment Muse requires and whether it can generate sufficient returns for Meta.

Meta closed Wednesday (the 30th) down 1.84% at $725.18 per share, up roughly 27% from $572.34 at the end of August. This represents the fifth‑largest monthly gain since the company went public, outpacing all large‑cap tech peers, while the Nasdaq index rose about 2% over the same period.

After launching Muse on September 8, the product quickly gained traction, surpassing OpenAI’s ChatGPT in download numbers on Apple’s iOS platform and fueling Wall Street optimism about the company’s business outlook.

CEO Mark Zuckerberg also positioned Muse as the core of Meta’s product and business strategy at the annual Connect developer conference in September, unveiling new hardware such as the Muse Charm AI pendant.
Nevertheless, Muse’s success has drawn greater scrutiny to the return on AI investment.

StoneX analyst Mark Zgutowicz wrote in a Wednesday research note that Muse’s infrastructure demands are markedly higher, raising concerns about Meta’s capital return on invested capital (ROIC). He maintains a “hold” rating on Meta.
Meta expects its capital expenditures this year to double to roughly $140 billion to keep pace with large‑cap tech rivals in the AI race.
Some investors worry whether this spending wave will generate enough payoff, and Zgutowicz believes Muse will add to the pressure.

Competition is heating up after Muse’s debut. OpenAI announced on Tuesday (the 29th) that it will launch an AI agent called Dots, currently offered as a paid service; Zgutowicz expects OpenAI will eventually roll out a usage‑limited free tier to broaden consumer adoption and funnel users toward paid plans.
Meta continues to expand Muse’s commercial applications, launching Muse for Small Business on Tuesday aimed at small enterprises.
This week Meta also hired MongoDB CEO CJ Desai to lead the newly created Meta Enterprise Platform division, further positioning the company in the enterprise AI market.
Bank of America Global Research analysts estimated in a Monday report that the enterprise AI solutions market, including cloud computing capacity, will exceed $1 trillion by 2028.

Analysts say Meta’s trove of consumer data and communication apps could help the company sell AI services to enterprises whose primary customers are consumers, and they expect Meta’s model APIs to be offered through major cloud platforms.

Meta’s last larger monthly gain occurred in November 2022 when OpenAI released ChatGPT. After a tough year, Meta’s stock rebounded as efficiency initiatives took hold; now Muse is again driving market expectations, delivering Meta’s best monthly performance since November 2022.

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉美債壓力籠罩 道瓊跌逾440點 月季線雙收黑
items.title_en: US After-Hours: Treasury Pressure Overshadows Dow, S&P 500 Falls Over 440 Points, Nasdaq Holds Gains
paras: 美國 8 月通膨數據低於預期，帶動市場下修聯準會 (Fed) 10 月升息押注，但長天期美債殖利率持續攀升，壓抑股市表現。美股週三 (30 日) 漲跌互見，道瓊下挫逾 440 點，標普 500 同步收黑，那斯達克則受科技股支撐逆勢收紅。
隨著 9 月及第三季交易正式落幕，科技股表現相對亮眼。回顧 9 月表現，那指單月上漲約 1.9%，標普微幅下跌 0.5%，道瓊則下挫 4.3%。若以第三季整體來看，標普累計上揚 2%，那指攀升 2.5%，道瓊則疲軟收跌 2.7%。
週三公布的 8 月個人消費支出物價指數 (PCE) 年增 3.4%，低於市場預期的 3.7%，排除食品與能源的核心 PCE 月增 0.2%、年增 3%，也低於預期的 0.3% 與 3.3%。這項聯準會偏好的通膨指標，強化市場對央行可以暫緩升息的看法，支撐科技股表現。
根據芝商所 (CME Group) 數據，交易員預估聯準會 10 月升息的機率降至約 37%，低於一週前的逾 70%，但市場仍普遍預期 12 月將升息。
紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯 (John Williams) 前一日表示，10 月升息「沒有急迫性」，也促使市場重新評估短期政策路徑。
10 年期美債殖利率週三盤中突破 5.3%，尾盤約報 5.298%，較前一天上升約 4 個基點；30 年期殖利率約報 5.642%，上升近 5 個基點。兩者分別處於 2002 年 4 月與 6 月以來的高檔。
就業方面，ADP 報告顯示，美國 9 月民間企業新增 9 萬個就業機會，高於 8 月的 3.6 萬個，反映招聘增長加快。
另一方面，美伊和平談判停滯，加上美國燃料市場供應吃緊，原油期貨週三收高。布蘭特原油 9 月累計上漲約 14%，創 7 月以來最大單月漲幅，西德州原油同期漲幅約 5%。
美股週三 (30 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭漲多跌少。Meta (META-US) 下跌 1.84%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 上漲 1.10%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 上漲 0.93%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 上漲 0.77%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 上漲 1.01%。
費城半導體族群漲跌互見。AMD (AMD-US) 上漲 0.69%；博通 (AVGO-US) 下跌 1.10%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 上漲 0.51%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 下跌 0.12%；高通 (QCOM-US) 下跌 0.03%。
記憶體族群與儲存族群漲跌不一。美光 (MU-US) 漲幅不到 0.01%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 漲 0.22%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 漲 0.59%；希捷 (STX-US) 漲 0.97%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 下跌 1.36%。
台股 ADR 集體收黑。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 下跌 0.16%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 下跌 1.88%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 下跌 0.93%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 下跌 0.24%。
企業新聞
記憶體晶片製造商美光 (MU-US) 週三股價近乎持平，盤後股價震盪。受惠於全球 AI 建置帶動記憶體需求，美光2026財年第四季營收達 542.3 億美元、調整後每股盈餘 33.42 美元，雙雙優於市場預期。
蘋果 (AAPL-US) 收高1.10% 至每股 333.02 美元，月線漲幅超 5%。Counterpoint 預測蘋果首款折疊機 iPhone Duo，今年有望賣出約 600 萬支。此外，外媒報導，蘋果籌備多年的首款「智慧家庭中樞」 (Smart Home Hub) 預計將於 10 月 13 日正式亮相。
Meta (META-US) 收低 1.84% 至每股 725.18 美元，受惠於個人 AI 代理 Muse 的市場熱度，Meta 9 月股價上漲約 27%，創 2022 年 11 月以來最佳單月表現。
莫德納 (MRNA-US) 重挫 5.35% 至每股 192.57 美元。花旗將其股票評等由「持有」調降至「賣出」，認為近期股價漲勢已超出基本面所能支撐的程度。此前，莫德納與Merck (MRK-US) 公布共同開發的癌症疫苗候選產品臨床進展，帶動莫德納股價大漲。
波音 (BA-US) 週三仍下跌 0.87% 至每股 186.05 美元，月跌幅約 10%。五角大廈選定波音開發美國海軍新一代 F/A-XX 戰機，合約價值 200 億美元，參與競標的諾斯洛普·格魯曼 (NOC-US) 下滑超 4%。
Cerebras (CBRS-US) 下殺超 8% 至每股 177.65 美元。半導體研究機構 SemiAnalysis 週二在社群媒體發文指出，OpenAI 最新 AI 模型 GPT6.1 Sol 的「Ultrafast」模式，使用的是輝達 (NVDA-US) 晶片，而非 Cerebras 的硬體。
Robinhood (HOOD-US) 收低 3.20% 至每股 112.50 美元。這家線上交易平台在休士頓舉行的峰會上宣布，將推出可代替使用者進行交易的 AI 代理，並提供週末全天候股票交易服務。
華爾街分析
Fifth Third Wealth Advisors 投資長 Chris Osmond 認為，經濟成長增強、通膨降溫與勞動市場穩健的組合，是有利股市的軟著陸訊號，既降低短期升息風險，也支持企業獲利成長預期。
U.S. Bank 資產管理資深投資策略主管 Rob Haworth 表示，他並未看到通膨預期大幅攀升，交易員關注的可能是較強的經濟成長。第二季國內生產毛額 (GDP) 上修，加上亞特蘭大聯準銀行對第三季成長的預估偏強，可能推升長天期殖利率。
不過，Janus Henderson Investors 全球多重資產主管暨投資組合經理 Adam Hetts 指出，雖然通膨數據優於預期，強勁的就業與 GDP 表現意味著，這次數據不太可能改變市場對年底前再度升息的普遍預期。
Chase Investment Counsel 總裁 Peter Tuz 則表示，通膨仍明顯高於聯準會目標，支持進一步升息，但許多企業即將迎來的財報季可望再度交出強勁成績，有機會支撐市場至少延續至 10 月底。
市場接下來將聚焦週五公布的美國 9 月非農就業報告。經濟學家預估新增就業人數為 8.4 萬人，約為 8 月經季節調整後新增人數的一半。
數字皆為截稿前更新，請依照實際報價為主
paras_en: U.S. August inflation data fell short of expectations, prompting the market to trim its October Fed rate hike bets, yet long‑term Treasury yields continued to climb, dampening equity performance. On Wednesday (30th), the U.S. stock market was mixed: the Dow fell more than 440 points, the S&P 500 closed lower, while the Nasdaq, buoyed by tech stocks, ended in the green.

With September and the third quarter officially concluding, tech stocks performed relatively well. Reviewing September, the Nasdaq rose about 1.9% for the month, the S&P 500 dipped 0.5%, and the Dow fell 4.3%. Looking at the entire third quarter, the S&P 500 gained 2%, the Nasdaq climbed 2.5%, and the Dow weakened, falling 2.7%.

The August Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) index rose 3.4% year‑over‑year, below the market’s 3.7% forecast. Core PCE, excluding food and energy, increased 0.2% month‑over‑month and 3% year‑over‑year, also below expectations of 0.3% and 3.3%. This Fed‑favored inflation gauge reinforced the view that the central bank could pause rate hikes, supporting tech stocks.
According to CME Group data, traders now estimate the probability of a Fed rate hike in October at about 37%, down from over 70% a week ago, yet the market still broadly expects a hike in December.
New York Fed President John Williams said the October rate hike “does not feel urgent,” prompting the market to reassess the short‑term policy path.

The 10‑year Treasury yield broke 5.3% mid‑session on Wednesday, ending around 5.298%, up about 4 basis points from the previous day; the 30‑year yield was about 5.642%, up nearly 5 basis points. Both are the highest levels since April and June 2002, respectively.
In employment, the ADP report showed that U.S. private‑sector jobs added 90,000 in September, higher than the 36,000 added in August, indicating a faster hiring pace.

Meanwhile, U.S.–Iran peace talks stalled, and U.S. fuel market supply tightened, pushing crude futures higher on Wednesday. Brent crude rose about 14% in September, the largest single‑month gain since July, while WTI rose about 5% in the same period.
U.S. stocks on Wednesday (30th) saw the following index performances:

The Dow Industrial Index fell 443.87 points, or 0.86%, to 50,906.05. The Nasdaq Index rose 63.52 points, or 0.24%, to 26,861.06. The S&P 500 Index fell 19.30 points, or 0.25%, to 7,651.54. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 0.54 points, or 0.0043%, to 12,628.62. The NYSE FANG+ Index rose 5.59 points, or 0.03%, to 19,121.87.
In the NYSE FANG+ tech giants, Meta (META‑US) fell 1.84%; Apple (AAPL‑US) rose 1.10%; Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) rose 0.93%; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) rose 0.77%; Amazon (AMZN‑US) rose 1.01%.

The Philadelphia Semiconductor group was mixed: AMD (AMD‑US) rose 0.69%; Broadcom (AVGO‑US) fell 1.10%; NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) rose 0.51%; Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) fell 0.12%; Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) fell 0.03%.

Memory and storage stocks were uneven: Micron (MU‑US) rose less than 0.01%; Western Digital (WDC‑US) rose 0.22%; SanDisk (SNDK‑US) rose 0.59%; Seagate (STX‑US) rose 0.97%; SK Hynix ADR (SKHY‑US) fell 1.36%.
Taiwan ADRs closed broadly lower: TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) fell 0.16%; ASE ADR (ASX‑US) fell 1.88%; UMC ADR (UMC‑US) fell 0.93%; Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT‑US) fell 0.24%.
Corporate news:

Micron’s stock hovered near flat on Wednesday, with after‑hours volatility. Benefiting from global AI deployment driving memory demand, Micron’s Q4 revenue for fiscal 2026 reached $54.23 billion and adjusted EPS was $33.42, both beating expectations.

Apple closed up 1.10% at $333.02 per share, with a monthly gain over 5%. Counterpoint predicts Apple’s first foldable iPhone Duo could sell about 6 million units this year. Additionally, foreign media reported that Apple’s long‑planned Smart Home Hub is slated to launch on October 13.

Meta closed down 1.84% at $725.18 per share, buoyed by the popularity of its personal AI agent Muse; Meta’s September share price rose about 27%, its best single‑month performance since November 2022.

Moderna fell 5.35% to $192.57 per share. Citi downgraded the stock from “Hold” to “Sell,” citing that recent price momentum exceeds what fundamentals can support. Previously, Moderna and Merck (MRK‑US) announced clinical progress on a joint cancer vaccine candidate, driving a sharp rally in Moderna’s shares.

Boeing closed down 0.87% at $186.05 per share, a monthly decline of about 10%. The Pentagon selected Boeing to develop the U.S. Navy’s next‑generation F/A‑XX fighter, a $20 billion contract, while Northrop Grumman (NOC‑US) fell over 4% in the bidding.

Cerebras fell more than 8% to $177.65 per share. Semiconductor research firm SemiAnalysis posted on social media that OpenAI’s latest GPT‑6.1 Sol “Ultrafast” mode uses NVIDIA chips, not Cerebras hardware.

Robinhood fell 3.20% to $112.50 per share. The online brokerage announced at a Houston summit that it will launch an AI agent to replace users for trading and offer 24‑hour weekend stock trading services.
Wall Street analysts:

Chris Osmond, portfolio manager at Fifth Third Wealth Advisors, believes that a combination of stronger economic growth, cooling inflation, and a robust labor market signals a soft landing for the market, reducing short‑term rate hike risk and supporting earnings growth expectations.

Rob Haworth, senior investment strategist at U.S. Bank Asset Management, said he did not see inflation expectations rising sharply; traders may be focused on stronger economic growth. A revised Q2 GDP and a strong Atlanta Fed outlook for Q3 growth could lift long‑term yields.

Adam Hetts, global multi‑asset manager at Janus Henderson Investors, noted that although inflation data beat expectations, strong employment and GDP suggest this data is unlikely to change the market’s expectation of another rate hike before year‑end.

Peter Tuz, president of Chase Investment Counsel, said inflation remains well above the Fed’s target, supporting further hikes, but many companies are poised to deliver strong earnings in the upcoming season, potentially sustaining the market at least through the end of October.
The market will next focus on the U.S. September non‑farm payroll report due Friday. Economists forecast 84,000 new jobs, about half the seasonally adjusted figure for August.

items.title: 馬斯克重返川普政府圈！攜Luckey、金瑞契操刀未來戰爭計畫
items.title_en: Musk Returns to Trump Administration Circle, Joining Luckey and Gingrich on Future War Plans
paras: 美國戰爭部長赫格塞斯(Pete Hegseth)周三(30日)宣布，特斯拉(TSLA-US)及SpaceX執行長馬斯克(Elon Musk)、國防科技公司Anduril創辦人Palmer Luckey，以及美國前眾議院議長Newt Gingrich，將共同領導一項名為「Project Meridian」的計畫，協助美國政府研究未來戰爭型態及軍事技術需求，並在120天內提出報告。
赫格塞斯是在維吉尼亞州匡提科海軍陸戰隊基地發表「State of the Force」演說時公布這項計畫。Project Meridian將由戰爭部首席技術長Emil Michael負責協調，馬斯克、Luckey及Gingrich則擔任共同領導人。三人在赫格塞斯演說當天已進行首次會議，計畫正式啟動。
根據戰爭部公布的委任內容，Project Meridian的任務不是制定傳統軍事戰略，而是研究未來戰爭可能出現的作戰領域，以及美軍需要掌握的能力與技術，並提出哪些武器與系統應該開始研發、測試及部署。研究範圍涵蓋人工智慧(AI)、自主系統、定向能量、機器人及生物科技等領域。
赫格塞斯表示，Project Meridian將研究未來戰場從地下環境一直延伸至地球與月球之間的近月空間(cislunar space)，評估美軍在不同作戰環境所需的技術與能力。戰爭部表示，研究小組將與聯合參謀部及各軍種的相關研究工作銜接，並尋找可以加速開發、測試及部署的技術。
計畫期限為120天，最終將提出一份公開的非機密報告，並附上一份機密附件。依戰爭部公布的時程，報告預計在2027年1月28日前完成。
馬斯克此次重新參與川普政府的官方工作，是他離開政府效率部(DOGE)相關職務後，再度以政府顧問角色參與美國政府工作。馬斯克同時掌管Tesla與SpaceX，前者投入人工智慧、自動駕駛及人形機器人，後者則涉及太空發射及衛星等業務，因此Project Meridian所涵蓋的AI、自主系統、機器人及太空領域，與其旗下企業的技術方向存在重疊。
Luckey則是Anduril的共同創辦人及核心領導者。Anduril主要開發自主系統、無人機、反無人機系統及其他國防科技產品，近年已取得多項美國政府國防合約。Gingrich則曾於1995年至1999年擔任美國眾議院議長，長期參與國防與國家安全政策討論。
此次任命也讓民間科技企業在美國軍事科技政策中的角色更加受到關注。馬斯克及Luckey旗下企業均已與美國政府存在國防業務關係，因此兩人在Project Meridian中的角色，除了研究未來戰爭科技，也可能使民間科技產業的技術經驗直接進入五角大廈的未來軍事規劃。不過，Project Meridian目前公布的任務是研究及提出建議，並未宣布由馬斯克或Luckey旗下企業直接取得任何新的採購合約。
Project Meridian是赫格塞斯當天公布的6項重大軍事改革措施之一。其中另一項核心計畫是成立「Autonomous Warfare Command」(自主戰爭司令部)，專門負責擴大無人機、機器人、人工智慧及自主系統在美軍各軍種的運用。戰爭部計畫讓這個新司令部在2027年10月前正式運作，並由四星上將領導。
赫格塞斯表示，自主及機器人技術正在改變軍事裝備、作戰準則及軍隊組織，因此需要透過新的指揮架構推動相關技術大規模部署。新的Autonomous Warfare Command將負責跨軍種整合自主系統，並加速無人機與機器人技術的採購、測試及部署。
戰爭部同時推動名為「Project Agincourt」的計畫，目標是改革無人系統的採購及部署方式。該計畫將配合自主戰爭司令部，透過競爭及測試機制加速採用成本較低、可大量生產的美國製無人系統。
赫格塞斯當天公布的另一項措施為「FORTRESS America」，目標是強化美國軍事基地及國防供應鏈的韌性。計畫涵蓋稀土、特殊金屬、半導體及推進劑等關鍵物資供應，同時要求主要軍事基地提高能源自主能力，使基地即使遭遇網路攻擊、破壞或民用電網中斷，也能維持電力及軍事運作。
赫格塞斯也提出在美國興建新的軍事基地，並計畫邀請各州政府提出基地選址方案。新基地預計容納約1.5萬至2.5萬名軍人，並將按照能源自主及現代化軍事設施標準建設。這將是美國數十年來新的大型軍事基地規劃之一。
此外，赫格塞斯宣布將在5所大學建立新的軍官培訓體系，並成立直接向他報告的宗教事務辦公室。當天公布的整體改革措施，涵蓋軍事指揮架構、無人及自主武器、國防供應鏈、軍事基地、軍官培訓及未來戰爭研究等多個領域。
赫格塞斯同日也宣布進一步縮減美軍高階軍官編制。他表示，目前將軍及海軍上將人數的整體削減幅度目標提高至20%，其中包括先前已執行的裁減及進一步降低將官職位數量的措施。這項調整與Project Meridian及自主戰爭司令部同時公布，反映戰爭部正在重新調整軍隊組織及軍事科技發展方向。
Project Meridian的研究成果將在120天內提交，公開報告將讓外界了解美國政府對未來戰爭領域及軍事科技的部分規劃，而機密附件則將涵蓋不適合公開的內容。由於研究範圍橫跨AI、自主武器、機器人、定向能量、生物科技及近月空間等領域，最終報告可能成為美軍後續技術研發、測試及採購方向的重要參考。
paras_en: U.S. Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth announced on Wednesday (the 30th) that Tesla (TSLA-US) and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, Anduril founder Palmer Luckey, and former House Speaker Newt Gingrich will jointly lead a project called "Project Meridian" to help the U.S. government study future war forms and military‑technology needs, with a report due in 120 days.

Hegseth unveiled the initiative during a "State of the Force" speech at the Quantico Marine Corps Base in Virginia. Project Meridian will be coordinated by the Department of Defense’s chief technology officer Emil Michael, with Musk, Luckey and Gingrich serving as co‑leaders. The three held their first meeting on the day of Hegseth’s speech, officially launching the effort.

According to the department’s mandate, Project Meridian is not tasked with drafting traditional military strategy but with researching potential future combat domains, the capabilities and technologies the U.S. military must master, and recommending which weapons and systems should begin development, testing and deployment. The study covers AI, autonomous systems, directed energy, robotics and biotechnology, among other areas.

Hegseth said the project will examine future battlefields ranging from subterranean environments to cislunar space between Earth and the Moon, assessing the technologies and capabilities needed for each. The study team will coordinate with the Joint Staff and the services’ research programs and look for ways to accelerate development, testing and fielding of promising technologies.

The effort is slated for 120 days, after which a public, unclassified report will be released along with a classified annex. Under the announced schedule, the final report is expected by January 28, 2027.

Musk’s re‑engagement with the Trump administration marks his return to a government advisory role after stepping down from his previous position at the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE). He continues to run Tesla and SpaceX, with Tesla focused on AI, autonomous driving and humanoid robots, and SpaceX on launch services and satellites, making the AI, autonomy, robotics and space topics of Project Meridian directly relevant to his companies.

Luckey is a co‑founder and core leader of Anduril, which builds autonomous systems, drones, counter‑drone solutions and other defense tech and has recently secured multiple U.S. defense contracts. Gingrich served as Speaker of the House from 1995 to 1999 and has long been involved in defense and national‑security policy discussions.

The appointments highlight the growing role of private‑sector tech firms in U.S. military‑technology policy. Both Musk’s and Luckey’s companies already have defense contracts, so their participation could channel commercial tech expertise into Pentagon planning, though the current mandate is limited to research and recommendations and does not award any new procurement contracts to their firms.

Project Meridian is one of six major reform measures announced by Hegseth that day. Another key initiative is the creation of an "Autonomous Warfare Command" to expand the use of drones, robots, AI and autonomous systems across all services, with the new command slated to be operational by October 2027 under a four‑star general.

Hegseth said autonomous and robotic technologies are reshaping equipment, tactics and force structure, requiring a new command architecture to drive large‑scale deployment. The Autonomous Warfare Command will integrate autonomous systems across services and accelerate procurement, testing and fielding of drones and robots.

The department is also launching "Project Agincourt," aimed at reforming how unmanned systems are bought and fielded. Paired with the Autonomous Warfare Command, the project will use competition and testing to speed adoption of lower‑cost, mass‑produced U.S.‑made unmanned systems.

Another measure unveiled was "FORTRESS America," intended to bolster the resilience of U.S. bases and the defense supply chain. The plan addresses critical materials such as rare earths, specialty metals, semiconductors and propellants, and requires major installations to achieve energy self‑sufficiency so they can operate despite cyber attacks, sabotage or civilian grid outages.

Hegseth also proposed building new military bases in the United States, inviting states to submit site proposals. The new installations would house roughly 15,000 to 25,000 personnel and be constructed to modern energy‑independent and facility‑modernization standards, representing one of the largest base‑building programs in decades.

In addition, he announced the creation of new officer‑training programs at five universities and the establishment of a religious‑affairs office reporting directly to him. The overall reform package announced that day spans command structure, unmanned and autonomous weapons, supply‑chain resilience, base construction, officer education and future‑war research.

Hegseth also said the Pentagon will further cut senior officer billets, raising the target reduction of generals and admirals to 20 percent, building on earlier cuts and additional reductions. This move, announced alongside Project Meridian and the Autonomous Warfare Command, reflects a broader re‑orientation of force structure and technology development.

The findings of Project Meridian will be submitted within the 120‑day window, with an unclassified report providing the public a view of the U.S. government’s planning for future war domains and military technology, while a classified annex will contain sensitive material. Because the study spans AI, autonomous weapons, robotics, directed energy, biotech and cislunar space, the final report could become a key reference for the services’ future R&D, testing and procurement decisions.

台股盤前要聞

paras_en: Taiwan stocks rebounded sharply on the 30th, led by electronic heavyweight stocks. Both panel giants hit their daily limits up, pushing the index up 748 points mid‑session to 48,379 before profit‑taking pressure set in. TSMC’s sharp sell‑off at the close knocked the index back below the 48,000 mark, leaving a long upper shadow, but the 5‑day moving average held. The index closed at 47,940.13, up 308.17 points, with a turnover of NT$875.6 billion, larger than the previous day.

Foxconn (2317‑TW) recorded employee dividends on the 30th. Boosted by AI‑driven revenue and strong profit growth, the average annual dividend per employee rose by double‑digit percentages compared with last year. High‑performing units and outstanding staff could receive bonuses of one million NT$ or more.

Bridgestone’s new tire plant in Hsinchu’s Hukou district, covering 19,000 ping, was auctioned on the 30th for NT$10.08888 billion. The winning bidder was Xinxing (3037‑TW), a maker of IC substrates and PCBs.

Minister of Economic Affairs Gong Ming‑xin, speaking at a Da‑Tong (2371‑TW) event, said the AI era is not only a competition of computing power and energy but also of national strength. The government plans to invest NT$100 billion over the next eight years to help SMEs adopt computing capacity and to roll out 25 large natural‑gas power units over the next ten years, delivering 2,000 GWh of electricity. He emphasized, “Da‑Tong is ready, the Ministry and Taiwan’s industry are ready,” ensuring power supply for AI infrastructure and industrial transformation.

Apple (AAPL‑US) will launch its first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, in October. Counterpoint Research preliminarily estimates sales of about 6 million units this year, though actual performance will depend on Apple’s ability to scale production.

Quanneng Semiconductor (00927‑TW), which has doubled its gains this year, announced its 14th dividend. The company proposes a NT$2 per unit payout, the highest quarterly dividend on record. Based on the September 30 closing price of NT$39.89, this implies a 5.03% single‑payment yield and an annualized yield of roughly 20.13%. The ex‑dividend date is set for October 19; investors must buy by October 16 to qualify, and the distribution date is November 13.

Taiwan stocks on the 30th narrowed gains after TSMC’s late‑session sell‑off, ending up 308 points at 47,940 and slipping below the 48,000 threshold, yet still defending the 5‑day line. All three major institutional investors were net buyers today, with foreign investors aggressively buying the “double‑D” group—panel leaders Innolux and AU Optronics, and memory players Powerchip and Winbond—totaling 264,000 contracts across four stocks.

AOI equipment maker Mude Technology (3563‑TW) held a corporate briefing on the 30th. The company said that as AI servers, high‑performance computing and high‑speed transmission applications expand, demand for advanced PCB, MSAP, ABF substrates and semiconductor advanced packaging testing will rise. By 2026, AI‑related equipment is expected to account for about 70% of its sales, climbing to 80‑90% in 2027 as overall revenue continues to grow.

The Taiwan Stock Exchange and the OTC market announced on the 30th that four stocks—high‑flyers Jia‑Jing (3016‑TW), Wei‑Hua Technology (3055‑TW) and Da‑Jia (2221‑TW)—will be suspended from trading starting the 1st until October 12. Yiqiang Technology (3219‑TW) will be suspended until October 7. Except for Yiqiang, which will trade on a 5‑minute matching cycle, the other three will use a 2‑minute matching cycle.
TSMC’s late‑session sell‑off erased the 48,000 level, but the index closed up 308 points with an upper shadow.
Foxconn’s annual dividend was credited today, up double‑digit percentages from last year, with top performers potentially receiving bonuses of one million NT$ or more.
AI‑driven expansion demand led Xinxing to secure the Bridgestone plant in Hukou, Hsinchu for over NT$10 billion.
Gong Ming‑xin: AI competition is also a national‑strength contest; the government is pouring NT$100 billion into computing power and expanding energy supply.
Counterpoint: Apple’s first foldable iPhone Duo is projected to sell 6 million units this year.
This year’s gains have doubled; Quanneng (00927) generously pays NT$2 per quarter, yielding an annualized dividend rate of about 20%.
Taiwan stocks hold the 5‑day line; all three major institutions are net buyers; foreign investors sweep the double‑D group for a total of 264,000 contracts.
Mude’s revenue will keep growing, with AI‑related equipment share rising to 80‑90%.
Four soaring stocks will be halted starting tomorrow; three of them have risen over 40% in the past six trading days—Jia‑Jing, Wei‑Hua Technology, suspended until 10/12.

items.title: 凱基金擬辦現金增資最多250億元 7成以上將挹注凱基證券
items.title_en: KGI Fund Plans Up to NT$250 Billion Cash Capital Increase, Over 70% to Be Invested in KGI Securities
paras: 凱基金控(2883-TW)今(30)日董事會通過辦理現金增資發行普通股案，發行股數以不超過7.2億股為限，預計募資規模約新台幣200億元至250億元，實際募資金額將依最終訂定之發行價格而定，本次規劃將有七成以上資金投入凱基證券。
凱基金控表示，受惠於AI產業發展帶動台灣經濟成長，以及資本市場持續活絡，企業籌資、財富管理及金融商品交易需求穩健成長。為掌握市場發展契機及支應業務擴張所需資本，本次增資資金規劃將有七成以上投入凱基證券，進一步強化業務發展及市場競爭力。此舉除有助於擴大核心業務規模，更可提升集團資本運用效率及未來獲利成長動能。
凱基證券今年前8月各項業務動能持續強勁，累計稅後純益達227.54億元，續創歷年同期新高，較去年同期成長235%，年化股東權益報酬率達44%領先同業。在投資銀行業務方面，深耕AI及半導體等核心產業，前八月主辦承銷總金額市占率接近四成，穩居市場第一；財富管理業務持續拓展台灣及香港市場，營收維持強勁成長；衍生性商品及股票期權等交易業務亦靈活掌握市場機會，持續挹注獲利貢獻。
凱基金控表示，本次增資除支應凱基證券未來業務發展所需資本外，也展現集團持續優化資本配置、聚焦高成長及高資本效率業務的策略方向。未來將持續透過審慎且積極的資本管理，強化核心競爭優勢，提升集團整體獲利能力與股東價值。
本次現金增資發行新股將依相關法令規定辦理，其中10%保留由員工認購、10%採公開申購方式辦理，其餘80%由原股東按持股比例優先認購。實際發行價格將於本案向主管機關申報生效後，依相關法令規定及市場狀況訂定，並據以辦理後續繳款及發行作業。
paras_en: KGI Fund Holding (2883-TW) today (30th) had its board approve a cash capital increase by issuing common shares, limited to no more than 720 million shares, with an expected fundraising amount of about NT$200 billion to NT$250 billion. The actual amount raised will depend on the final issue price, and more than 70% of the funds will be allocated to KGI Securities.

KGI Fund Holding said it benefits from the AI industry driving Taiwan’s economic growth and a continuously active capital market, with steady growth in corporate financing, wealth management, and financial product trading demand. To seize market opportunities and fund business expansion, over 70% of the capital raised will be invested in KGI Securities to further strengthen business development and market competitiveness. This move will not only expand the core business scale but also improve the group’s capital utilization efficiency and future profit growth momentum.

KGI Securities reported strong business momentum in the first eight months of this year, with cumulative after‑tax net profit reaching NT$22.754 billion, a record high for the same period, up 235% year‑on‑year, and an annualized return on equity of 44%, leading peers. In investment banking, deep involvement in AI and semiconductor core industries yielded a market‑share of nearly 40% in underwriting volume for the first eight months, keeping it at the top of the market; wealth management continued to expand in Taiwan and Hong Kong with robust revenue growth; derivative and stock option trading also flexibly captured market opportunities, continuously contributing to profit.

KGI Fund Holding said the capital increase not only provides the capital needed for KGI Securities’ future business development but also demonstrates the group’s ongoing strategy of optimizing capital allocation and focusing on high‑growth, high‑capital‑efficiency businesses. Going forward, it will continue prudent yet proactive capital management to strengthen core competitive advantages and enhance overall group profitability and shareholder value.

The new shares from this cash capital increase will be issued in accordance with relevant regulations, with 10% reserved for employee subscription, 10% offered through a public offering, and the remaining 80% allocated to existing shareholders on a pro‑rata basis. The actual issue price will be set after the filing is approved by regulators, based on applicable laws and market conditions, and will guide subsequent payment and issuance procedures.

items.title: 華航釋空服職缺 10/5起報名 最快明年1月中旬報到
items.title_en: China Airlines Opens Flight Attendant Vacancies, Applications Start Oct 5, Earliest Reporting Mid‑January Next Year
paras: 華航(2610-TW)宣布啟動 2026 下半年徵才計畫，隨著陸續引進新世代機隊並擴張全球航網，預計招募合計逾百名客艙組員和貨運營運人員。
華航表示，積極充實空服團隊，本次客艙組員招募將於 10 月 5 日至 12 日開放報名，初試和複試預計分別在 11 月 7 日及 11 月 14 日舉行，報名者須具備教育部認可學士學位以上學歷，以及多益聽讀 600 分以上或同等英語成績，錄取者最快明年 1 月中旬起陸續報到。
同時，華航深耕航空貨運市場，同步招募貨運營運人員，報名時間自 10 月 1 日起至 10 月 14 日，職務內容涵蓋管理全球客貨機航班貨運作業，包括平衡表製作和盤櫃規劃等。
華航居台灣航空貨運市場領先地位，正積極強化業務競爭力，今年已率先推出生成式 AI 貨運客服，並進一步擴充智慧訂位等功能，朝更高效率的工作模式邁進。
華航擁有完善教育訓練制度和職涯發展環境，提供員工和眷屬優待機票、社團活動、心理諮商和運動活動等，兼顧專業成長與生活品質，為配合營運發展需求，也將陸續開放各項職缺招募。
paras_en: China Airlines (2610‑TW) announced the launch of its 2026 second‑half recruitment drive. With the gradual introduction of a new‑generation fleet and the expansion of its global network, the airline plans to hire more than one hundred cabin crew members and cargo operation staff.

China Airlines said it is actively strengthening its flight‑attendant team. This cabin‑crew recruitment will accept applications from October 5 to October 12, with the first and second interviews scheduled for November 7 and November 14 respectively. Applicants must hold a bachelor’s degree or higher recognized by the Ministry of Education and have a TOEIC listening‑reading score of at least 600 or an equivalent English qualification. Successful candidates could begin reporting as early as mid‑January next year.

At the same time, China Airlines, which is deepening its presence in the air‑cargo market, is also hiring cargo operation personnel. Applications are open from October 1 to October 14, and the roles cover management of global passenger‑and‑cargo flight cargo operations, including balance‑sheet preparation and container‑planning.

China Airlines, the leader in Taiwan’s air‑cargo market, is actively enhancing its competitive edge. This year it pioneered a generative‑AI‑powered cargo customer‑service system and is further expanding smart‑booking functions, moving toward a more efficient work model.

China Airlines offers a comprehensive education‑training system and career‑development environment, providing employees and their families with preferential tickets, club activities, psychological counseling, and sports programs. Balancing professional growth with quality of life, the airline will continue to open various job openings to meet operational development needs.

items.title: 資服業新兵報到 藍新資訊以AI維運平台搶占高門檻利基市場
items.title_en: New Entrant in the IT Services Sector: Blue New Information Seizes High‑Barrier Niche Market with AI Operations Platform
paras: 資訊服務業又有新兵報到，藍新資訊(6938-TW)將於10月1日舉辦上櫃前業績發表會，預計10月中旬掛牌上櫃，總經理楊璦如表示，已形成「建置帶動維護維運、維護維運帶動優化」的服務循環，過去三年維護維運合約年複合成長率約14.5%，三年平均合約存續率超過90%，持續性收入占營收比重達40%，成營運穩定的基礎，後續將聚焦客戶推動AI算力導入、混合雲架構升級和零信任資安治理的龐大商機。
藍新資訊從大型主機出發，主要服務ERP、MES、HIS、金融行業交易系統和資料庫等關鍵應用所需的資訊運作平台，涵蓋雲端、儲存、網路資安和AI，並由規劃、建置一路承接維護與維運，目前服務客戶超過400家，今年前8月合併營收4.29億元，年增26.24%。
藍新資訊說明，業務門檻偏高，在於政府機關、金融行業及大型企業的核心系統涉及跨平台架構、既有系統相容性和營運不中斷要求，供應商除須具備規劃和建置能力，更需長期累積實際維運經驗，而客戶一旦導入即不易更換，形成有別於一般系統整合商的競爭門檻。
技術面上，藍新資訊專業工程團隊逾90人，累積超過600張技術認證，集中於大型核心主機、雲端虛擬化、AI數據存儲和資訊安全四大領域，並與IBM、NetApp、HPE、Dell、Cisco、Palo Alto、F5及Veeam等國際原廠建立長期合作關係，多次取得原廠傑出夥伴獎項。
為強化AI布局，藍新資訊於去年已成立智能應用發展部，並取得多項AI伺服器、高階GPU運算平台及AI商業應用導入的銷售實績，今年上半年占營收比重快速成長至8%。
藍新科進一步說明，不同於單純銷售AI伺服器，藍新資訊將AI布局定位為既有企業IT架構的延伸，未來將聚焦政府、金融機構與大型企業核心系統，持續擴大發展高門檻、高黏著度的利基市場。
paras_en: Information services welcome a new player as Blue New Information (6938‑TW) will hold a pre‑listing performance briefing on October 1 and plans to list on the OTC market in mid‑October. General manager Yang Airu said the company has established a service cycle of “building drives maintenance and operations, maintenance and operations drive optimization.” Over the past three years, maintenance‑and‑operations contracts grew at a compound annual rate of about 14.5%, with an average contract renewal rate exceeding 90%. Recurring revenue now accounts for 40% of total sales, providing a stable operating foundation. Going forward, the firm will focus on large opportunities in AI compute adoption, hybrid‑cloud upgrades and zero‑trust security governance for its customers.

Blue New Information started from large‑scale mainframes, primarily providing the information‑operations platforms needed for critical applications such as ERP, MES, HIS, financial transaction systems and databases. Its offerings span cloud, storage, network security and AI, covering everything from planning and construction to ongoing maintenance and operations. The company now serves more than 400 customers and recorded combined revenue of NT$429 million for the first eight months of this year, a year‑over‑year increase of 26.24%.

The company explained that the high entry barrier stems from the core systems of government agencies, financial institutions and large enterprises, which involve cross‑platform architectures, legacy system compatibility and uninterrupted operation requirements. Suppliers must not only have planning and implementation capabilities but also long‑term, hands‑on operational experience. Once a client adopts the solution, switching vendors is difficult, creating a competitive moat distinct from typical system integrators.

On the technical side, Blue New Information’s professional engineering team exceeds 90 staff and holds more than 600 technical certifications, focusing on four major domains: large‑scale core mainframes, cloud virtualization, AI data storage and information security. The firm has long‑term partnerships with international vendors such as IBM, NetApp, HPE, Dell, Cisco, Palo Alto, F5 and Veeam, and has repeatedly earned outstanding partner awards from these manufacturers.

To strengthen its AI positioning, Blue New Information established an Intelligent Application Development Department last year and has secured multiple sales of AI servers, high‑end GPU computing platforms and AI business‑application implementations. In the first half of this year, AI‑related revenue grew rapidly to represent 8% of total sales.

Blue New Information further clarified that, unlike pure AI‑server sales, its AI strategy is framed as an extension of existing enterprise IT architectures. Going forward, the company will concentrate on core systems of governments, financial institutions and large enterprises, continuously expanding its high‑barrier, high‑stickiness niche market.

items.title: 全球央行掀去美元購金潮 兆豐009832掌握黃金槓桿爆發力
items.title_en: Global Central Banks Spark Gold Buying Wave, Mega Financial 009832 Captures Gold Leverage Power
paras: 全球金融市場迎來多元配置新時代！在去美元化趨勢成形、地緣政治避險情緒升溫，以及美國聯準會重啟降息循環等推波助瀾下，全球央行自 2020 年起掀起強勁的「購金熱潮」。法人指出，隨著實質利率走低與地緣政治風險加劇，國際頂尖投行對金價後市看法極度樂觀，摩根大通預估 2027 年金價將上看每盎司 6,300 美元，更有中小型券商喊出 8,600 美元的天價。看好黃金產業槓桿效應，兆豐投信推出全台首檔黃金礦業 ETF—兆豐美國黃金礦業 ETF(009832-TW)。
兆豐美國黃金礦業 ETF 經理人吳朋鴻表示，黃金具備「避險資產首選、長期儲存價值、無主權違約風險」三大核心特性。自 2008 年金融海嘯後，美國經歷四次量化寬鬆(QE)，導致美元購買力大幅縮水；加上俄烏戰爭與中東地緣政治衝突等因素，許多新興市場央行(如中國、土耳其、巴西)為防範美元資產遭凍結，紛紛減少美債與美元儲備，進而大舉轉向增持無法憑空印製的黃金。
根據 2026 年中央銀行黃金儲備調查，高達 84% 受訪央行預計未來五年將繼續提高黃金佔總儲備的比率。歐洲央行(ECB)資料亦顯示，歐洲各央行黃金配置比率已從 20% 飆升至 27%，在央行買盤長線護盤與稀缺性撐腰下，奠定了黃金資產的長線戰略地位。
面對黃金投資熱潮，吳朋鴻強調，投資黃金已從 1.0 的實體金條(保管難、無利息)與 2.0 的黃金存折/期貨 ETF(交易成本高、無配息)，演進至 3.0 的「黃金礦業 ETF」。
黃金礦業股票具備獨特的「營運槓桿效應」，以「麵包店」概念舉例，黃金價格如同麵包售價，金礦公司則是生產麵包的企業。當國際金價上漲，而開採成本控制得宜時，企業獲利呈倍數擴大，帶動公司 EPS 與評價面(P/E)雙提升。
歷史數據驗證，在 2019 年至 2025 年間，國際金價平均年漲 20.6%，但 009832 追蹤的「NYSE TIP 美國黃金礦業指數」年均漲幅達 35.5%；2025 年金價大漲 64.6% 時，該指數更飆升 163.5%，展現遠高於金價的價格彈性與爆發力。
009832 追蹤 NYSE TIP 美國黃金礦業指數精選 55 檔在美國掛牌、市值達標(7.5 億美元以上)的高純度金銀龍頭企業，黃金約占 90.2%、白銀占 9.8%。
009832 前十大成分股囊括全球三大黃金生產商(如道瓊成分股 Newmont、Barric 等)，同時納入兼具 AI 與光伏剛性需求的白銀龍頭。更特別的是，成分股包含被譽為「礦業銀行家」的貴金屬權利金與金屬分潤公司(如 Wheaton)。這類公司提供礦商融資，並得以極高折扣價(如以每盎司 400 美元取得市場價 4,000 美元的黃金)獲取成品，在金價多頭格局下，獲利更具爆發性成長力。
paras_en: Global financial markets are ushering in a new era of diversified allocation! Driven by the formation of a de‑dollarisation trend, heightened geopolitical‑risk hedging sentiment, and the U.S. Federal Reserve’s restart of a rate‑cut cycle, central banks worldwide have launched a strong “gold‑buying frenzy” since 2020. Analysts note that with real rates falling and geopolitical risks intensifying, top international investment banks are extremely bullish on gold’s outlook – JPMorgan projects gold to reach $6,300 per ounce by 2027, and some boutique brokers even quote a sky‑high $8,600. Seeing the leverage effect of the gold industry, Mega Financial Investment Trust introduced Taiwan’s first gold‑mining ETF – Mega US Gold Mining ETF (009832‑TW).

Mega US Gold Mining ETF manager Wu Peng‑hong says gold possesses three core attributes: “the top‑choice hedge asset, long‑term store of value, and no sovereign default risk.” Since the 2008 financial crisis, the U.S. has undergone four rounds of quantitative easing, eroding the dollar’s purchasing power. Coupled with the Russia‑Ukraine war and Middle‑East geopolitical tensions, many emerging‑market central banks (e.g., China, Turkey, Brazil) have reduced U.S. Treasury and dollar reserves to avoid asset freezes, shifting heavily toward gold, which cannot be printed out of thin air.

According to the 2026 central‑bank gold‑reserve survey, a staggering 84% of respondents expect to increase gold’s share of total reserves over the next five years. ECB data also show that European central banks’ gold allocation has jumped from 20% to 27%, cementing gold’s long‑term strategic position under sustained central‑bank buying and scarcity support.

Facing the gold‑investment boom, Wu Peng‑hong emphasizes that gold investing has evolved from 1.0 physical bars (hard to store, no interest) and 2.0 gold accounts/futures ETFs (high transaction costs, no dividends) to 3.0 “gold‑mining ETFs.”

Gold‑mining stocks exhibit a unique operating‑leverage effect. Using a “bakery” analogy, gold price is like the price of bread, and mining companies are the bakers. When international gold prices rise while extraction costs are well‑controlled, profits multiply, boosting both EPS and valuation multiples (P/E).

Historical data show that from 2019 to 2025, global gold prices rose an average of 20.6% per year, whereas the “NYSE TIP US Gold Mining Index” tracked by 009832 posted a 35.5% annual gain. In 2025, when gold surged 64.6%, the index jumped 163.5%, demonstrating price elasticity and explosive growth far exceeding the metal itself.

009832 tracks the NYSE TIP US Gold Mining Index, which selects 55 high‑purity gold‑silver leaders listed in the U.S. with market caps above $750 million. The portfolio is roughly 90.2% gold and 9.8% silver.

The fund’s top ten holdings include the world’s three largest gold producers (e.g., Newmont and Barrick, both Dow Jones components) and silver leaders with AI and photovoltaic demand. Notably, the basket also contains precious‑metal royalty and streaming firms (e.g., Wheaton), dubbed “mining bankers.” These companies finance miners and acquire metal at deep discounts (e.g., $400 per ounce for market‑price $4,000 gold), delivering explosive profit potential in a bullish gold environment.

items.title_en: United States Leads Taiwan's Bank Exposure for 11 Consecutive Years, Share of Total Debt Tops 30% at a Record High
paras: 台灣央行今(30)日公布6月底本國銀行國家風險統計，美國連續44個季度蟬聯我國曝險最大國，曝險金額達2225.28億美元，占總債務比重30.28%也創歷史新高。
央行指出，儘管國銀對中國曝險仍居第三，但美中曝險的差距額持續擴大，主要是因對美國有價證券投資增加、以及存放款增加，隨著台灣科技業者赴美擴大投資，後續持續關注。
央行統計，截至6月底本國銀行依直接交易對手基礎統計的外國債權餘額為7350億美元，較第一季底增加4.61%，主要因對非銀行的私人部門債權增加。
我國曝險前10大國家(地區)依序為美國、盧森堡、中國大陸、澳大利亞、日本、香港、英國、新加坡、法國和越南，合計5466億美元，順序較上季並未有改變，占直接交易對手基礎外國債權餘額74.37%，較上季增加0.83個百分點。
paras_en: Taiwan’s central bank today (30th) released its national risk statistics for domestic banks as of the end of June. The United States has topped Taiwan’s exposure rankings for 44 consecutive quarters, with exposure amounting to US$222.528 billion, representing 30.28% of total debt – a historic high.

The central bank noted that although domestic banks’ exposure to China remains the third‑largest, the gap with the United States is widening, driven by increased investments in U.S. securities and higher deposits. With Taiwanese technology firms expanding investments in the United States, the bank will continue to monitor the situation closely.

According to the bank’s statistics, as of the end of June domestic banks’ foreign‑credit balances, measured on a direct counterparty basis, stood at US$735 billion, up 4.61% from the end of the first quarter, mainly due to higher credit to non‑bank private‑sector entities.

The top ten countries/regions of Taiwan’s exposure are, in order, the United States, Luxembourg, Mainland China, Australia, Japan, Hong Kong, the United Kingdom, Singapore, France and Vietnam, totaling US$546.6 billion. The ranking order is unchanged from the previous quarter, accounting for 74.37% of foreign‑credit balances on a direct counterparty basis, an increase of 0.83 percentage points from the prior quarter.
